summary: Archive IMAP cutover completed. Node1 serves both messages through Dovecot 2.2.22; node2 authenticates as archive and retrieves the exact Message-IDs, bodies, and read/unread states. The staged source remains checksum-identical. Both nodes were restarted individually and fully recovered with changed boot identities.

Created the archive account and generated a dedicated demonstration password on node1, stored root-only.
Copied the staged mailbox into the live Maildir while preserving the original source.
Enabled Dovecot at boot and exposed IMAP on port 143.
Verified retrieval from node2 using read-only IMAP operations.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified persistence and recovery.
